## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the result of this change. Link any related issue.

## Testing

List the checks you ran and their results. For hardware or RF tests, include the board, LR2021 ROM version, frequency, measuring receiver and what you observed. Say what remains untested.

## Captures or screenshots

Add plots, captures or screenshots if they help. Remove this section if it does not apply.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] `cmake --build build` and `ctest --test-dir build` pass, or I explained why they do not apply.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private data and other people's communications from code, logs and captures.
- [ ] Any transmit testing used a frequency and power I am permitted to use.
- [ ] I preserved third-party notices and documented any new dependencies.
